content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Core business is electric power generation and distribution; telephone service is secondary, unlike ATN's telecom operator model."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Sells billing and network software and outsourced IT services to operators; it does not run connectivity networks."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Cloud phone software and web hosting for small businesses; no owned networks or rural wireless or broadband service."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Integrated Alaska telco selling wireless, broadband, enterprise and government connectivity over its own networks, like ATN."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Cloud communications software sold as subscriptions; it runs no connectivity networks and serves a different customer base."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Rural telecom operator selling broadband, voice and business connectivity over its own fiber and telephone networks."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Rural and midsize wireless and wireline operator with own networks, selling consumer and business connectivity, similar to ATN."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Primarily a REIT leasing fiber and copper capacity to carriers; retail broadband is secondary to wholesale infrastructure leasing."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Satellite broadband plus defense electronics manufacturing; differs in technology, end markets and product mix from ATN."}]}
